scene_records.event: wounding and altered perception under extreme threat
scene_records.delta2_state: heroic desire + life threat/nature -> illusion collapse -> later path dependence
scene_records.mechanism: A high-cost event can invalidate a previously dominant model of desired life and redirect later choices.
scene_records.variation: The same extreme event may reinforce or overturn a prior worldview depending on the agent's existing model.
scene_records.loss_risk: High if reduced to a generic battlefield revelation.

scene_records.event: capture, deprivation, and contact with Karataev

post_state.KNOWLEDGE: ordinary life becomes more salient than abstract systems

scene_records.delta2_state: deprivation removes intellectual defenses and generates solidarity/internal freedom
scene_records.trajectory: intellectual/ideological project -> deprivation -> simplification -> internal reorientation
scene_records.mechanism: Severe external constraints can remove previously available identity supports and expose alternative value structures.
scene_records.variation: Constraint can lead to collapse, adaptation, solidarity, or resistance.
scene_records.loss_risk: High if captivity is reduced to a generic lesson or friendship.

scene_records.event: attempted elopement with Anatole and resulting scandal
scene_records.delta2_state: romantic impulse + scandal -> ego/worldview collapse -> later moral maturity
scene_records.mechanism: A socially consequential choice can alter both relationship state and the agent's model of self.
scene_records.variation: The same social consequence can produce denial, shame, adaptation, or growth.
scene_records.loss_risk: High if reduced to a romance scandal.

global_change_patterns: extreme event -> prior worldview/goal model collapse -> reorientation
deprivation -> removal of prior supports -> alternative value basis
socially consequential choice -> relationship consequence -> self-model change
trajectory_candidates: ideological project -> deprivation -> simplification -> internal reorientation
work_specific_variable_policy: These are retained as observed/work-specific variables and are not promoted to canonical variables from one work alone.
